results.title: Bookends
results.overview: Nate is an excitable millennial novelist forced to leave his fabulous city life behind and move in with his grandparents after a bad breakup. But when his Holocaust-surviving grandfather Saul shows signs of cognitive decline and his grandmother Miriam refuses to acknowledge her husband’s early signs of dementia, Nate finds himself torn between his desire to escape retirement community life, family responsibilities, and an unexpected romance with his grandparents’ doctor.

results.title: Life Coach

results.title: Isabel
results.overview: Isabel, a sommelière in São Paulo, dreams of escaping her boss and opening her own bar. When plans don’t go as expected, she must decide whether to halt everything or take bold steps to uncork her fate on her own terms.

results.title: The Diego Nobody Saw
results.overview: An intimate documentary about Diego Armando Maradona, told from a unique perspective: through the eyes of someone who quietly stood by his side, capturing moments the world had never seen. Through exclusive photos and private videos, the film reveals Diego beyond the stadium and the myth, showing his most human side. For years, Jorge Luengo witnessed defining and everyday moments of Maradona?s life.

results.title: Manifesto
results.overview: Follow, if you can, jazz driven inventor and tweed jacketed intellectual Jaque Gorgeaux, flung on a roller coaster ride through new and bizarre dimensions in time, light and mind as he removes the mask of sanity and dives within the strange interior of his self actualisation machine, the Mysterium Device.  Realities collide and merge as one as our hapless professor pursues the fearful redemption of the deadly but darkly erotic Moon Goddess Ilunia, hurled through an inner realm filled with weird and wonderfully frightening characters emerging from his subconscious on this, a quest to know the very nature of the quest itself!

results.title: I Is Another
results.overview: Autumn 1952: Committed journalist Hedda and her husband Winfried ambush Felix Kersten, former massage therapist to SS Reich Leader Himmler, on a train to Oslo. Kersten is said to have helped thousands of concentration camp prisoners to freedom during the Nazi era—at least according to his own account. But Hedda has her doubts. She considers Kersten a mythmaker who is using fabricated heroic deeds to put himself in the running for the Nobel Peace Prize. What begins as an interview develops into a tense, psychological cat-and-mouse game: Kersten, rhetorically brilliant and armed with alleged evidence, encounters a stubborn opponent who relentlessly confronts him with contradictions. As the conversation comes to a head, the announcement of the Nobel Peace Prize winner draws ever closer....

results.title: Death Knight

results.title: Sweet 16
results.overview: The story follows a spoiled, wealthy city girl who is counting down the days to a glamorous, supersonic 16th birthday party where she expects a car as a gift. Her world is turned completely upside down when she is unexpectedly tricked and sent to live in a village for her summer holidays. Forced onto a journey of humility, she must use her sassiness to bring redemption to the village and discover her true self.
